biotools.summary: Q-BioLiP is a database providing comprehensive, quaternary structure-based protein-ligand interactions. It addresses limitations in the original BioLiP resource by representing proteins in their quaternary structures, providing experimental and predicted binding affinities, and retaining both biologically relevant and irrelevant interactions.
